title: feat(cli,lint)!: os validate and os build refuse seed records the seed load would drop
body:
repo:objectstack#7 · os-alice · session_011y7As5bdhV5T4N9vpjmZzH

Fixes #35653

Clause-②: yes (narrowing)
Metadata-protocol: narrowed
Skills-docs: follow-up #37158 — skills/objectstack-data/references/seeds.md (its sentence "`os validate` does not run them on seed rows" becomes false with this change; `skills/**` is out of this domain:devx claim)

## 维护者速读

- 用户能看到什么变化：写应用的人运行校验或构建命令时，如果某条初始化数据会被该对象自己的校验规则拒收，或者唯一标识留空，命令会直接失败并指出是哪条数据、哪条规则；以前要等到启动后看日志才发现数据被丢掉。
- 为什么做：属于“构建与校验提前报错”这一组改进，替写初始化数据的应用作者解决“构建通过、启动时数据悄悄丢失”的问题；同时并入了“唯一标识留空只在加载时拒收”那张卡。
- 出错会怎样：原本能通过校验的配置现在可能被拒（这是有意收紧）；判不准的组合只计数提示、不拒收，加载时的拒收照旧兜底，撤回本改动即可恢复原状。
- 要你做什么：这是一项声明过的收紧（破坏性变更），需要你批准或直接合并，席位不能自己落地。

## What changes

`os validate` and `os build` now judge every seed record before the load does and refuse the config (exit 1) when the seed load would drop a record:

- **A record its object's own validation rule refuses.** The walk is `judgeSeedRowRefusals` (`@objectstack/lint`); the verdict is the write path's own evaluator, `evaluateValidationRules` (`@objectstack/objectql`), injected by the two CLI doors (lint cannot import the runtime). Each rule is judged on its own, so the finding names the refusing rule. Only active, error-severity rules that judge inserts are run; `state_machine` is skipped, as the seed write skips it.
- **A keyed record with a blank key field** (the folded row): no value, `null` or `''` in a field of the dataset's `externalId`, reported in the exact sentence the seed loader refuses it with (a CLI test holds the two equal against the real loader). The object's own organization column is left to the load, which stamps it: the column `resolveTenantFieldName` (`@objectstack/core`, injected by the doors like the evaluator) walls the object by, so a declared `tenancy.tenantField` the object has, else `organization_id`.
- A (record, rule) pair is judged only when the record's own literal values decide it. A rule that reads something the load decides (a reference hop, a roll-up / formula / autonumber field, a default, a platform-injected column, an expression or `seedFile` value, a `beforeInsert` hook's write, an `update` dataset's stored row, a non-`record` root) is counted in one dim note and never refused, so a refusal here is a record the load refuses.
- Human output, one line per refusal (the heading counts records): `✗ data[0].records[1]: Seed record #1 of 'xt_payment' is refused by its validation rule 'amount_positive': A payment amount must be positive.` `--json` carries the refusals under `errors` (`os validate`) or `issues` (`os build`), each with `rule`, `location`, `object`, `recordIndex`, and `validationRule` or `field`.
- ADR-0087: the narrowing registers the upgrade-guide entry `seed-record-refused-before-load` (`packages/spec/src/migrations/entries/semantic/18.seed-record-refused-before-load.ts`); the changeset carries `registered seed-record-refused-before-load`. The load-time half of the blank key is the existing entry `seed-key-blank-record-refused`.
- Changeset: `@objectstack/cli`, `@objectstack/lint`, `@objectstack/spec` minor (fixed group), a `feat(cli)!:` headline, a **BREAKING** paragraph with its FROM and TO, both declaration lines and `Skills-docs: follow-up #37158`.

Files to read first, by risk:
1. `packages/lint/src/seed-row-refusals.ts` — `fieldKnown` / `ruleReads`: the judged-vs-not-judged boundary. A pair wrongly judged is a false refusal at build; the walk errs toward not judging.
2. `packages/cli/src/commands/validate.ts` step 3d-quater and `packages/cli/src/commands/compile.ts` step 4a-0-bis — the two door call sites (same call, same exit behaviour).
3. `packages/spec/src/migrations/entries/semantic/18.seed-record-refused-before-load.ts` — the upgrade-guide text an upgrading author reads.

## Tests

- `packages/lint/src/seed-row-refusals-35653.test.ts` (18 tests): the walk with a recording evaluator double — refusal naming, one rule per call with field-level predicates stripped, a non-`VALIDATION_FAILED` throw propagates, every not-judged reason counted and not handed to the evaluator, what the load skips is skipped uncounted, blank key (single, composite, expression and organization column left to the load, and an object walled by its own `tenancy.tenantField`).
- `packages/cli/test/seed-row-refusals-35653.test.ts`: the real evaluator through the real stack parse — a refused record named by rule, a passing control, a roll-up rule not judged although the evaluator handed the raw record would refuse it, a fail-closed rule reported; the blank-key sentence equal to the real `SeedLoaderService` dry run's, and a dataset keyed on a declared `tenancy.tenantField` refused by neither the walk nor the real loader on the record that leaves it to the stamp.
- `packages/cli/test/seed-row-refusals-35653-doors.test.ts` (integration tier, spawns the CLI): `os validate --json` and `os build --json` both exit 1 with the two findings.

## Acceptance notes

- "Names the seed file": a config-loaded stack carries no per-dataset source path, so a finding names the dataset by its position in the stack (`data[0]`, `packages[1].manifest.data[0]`), its object, the record index and the rule. This is the same location convention the existing seed-value and seed-file findings use.
- The published skill `skills/objectstack-data/references/seeds.md` says "`os validate` does not run them on seed rows"; this PR makes that false. Out of this claim's surface (`skills/**`), carried by #37158 (release-coupled: lands before the release that ships this narrowing).
- Not judged by design (counted, left to the load): rules reading beyond the record's literal values, `update` datasets, objects with a `beforeInsert` hook, date/datetime and other non-literal field types. Silence is not a promise the load admits the record.
- Contract review is owed before the queue (declared narrowing, `Metadata-protocol: narrowed`), with the dogfood battery at the final head (below).

## Verification

Two-minute check: in any app with a validation rule, add a seed record that breaks it and run `os validate`; expect exit 1 and a line `✗ data[N].records[M]: Seed record #M of 'OBJECT' is refused by its validation rule 'RULE_NAME': RULE_MESSAGE`. Restore the record; expect exit 0.

<details><summary>Test Core (9/10) red on cb30582ea3b</summary>

The host-config case of `packages/cli/src/commands/migrate/plan.boot-parity.integration.test.ts` (line 145, a pending `create_table` for `sys_activity`, job 138857802200) did not reproduce after the merge: green in CI at `72ae1b5e17a` (Test Core (9/10), 3 tests) and locally at `84156fae352` (above). The diff touches neither `os serve`, `os migrate plan`, the audit plugin nor `sys_activity`. No root cause is established from one red; the same log has the audit plugin reporting `sys_activity` provisioned during the boot, so a provisioning race in the provision-and-exit boot is a hypothesis, not a finding.
